question: We want to study if Vitamin D can increase the incidence of breast cancer. In our area we have a population registry of cancer. To achieve our goal, all women diagnosed with breast cancer are selected from the register we have and each case pairs with two controls. What study design has been chosen?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Population registry of cancer" -> "All women diagnosed with breast cancer selected" -> "Each case pairs with two controls" -> "Case-control study nested" -> 95%
CHAIN: "Population registry of cancer" -> "All women diagnosed with breast cancer selected" -> "Each case pairs with two controls" -> "Cases and controls study" -> 90%
analysis: The study design described involves selecting women diagnosed with breast cancer (cases) and pairing them with controls from the same population registry. This design allows for the comparison of exposure to Vitamin D between cases and controls to assess its potential impact on the incidence of breast cancer.
